ai_summary: Mi Remote's voice control is a hybrid pipeline: AudioRecord(16 kHz mono/16-bit) -> local VAD and Opus encode inside libmibrainsdk.so -> protobuf over TLS WebSocket to wss://speech.ai.xiaomi.com/speech/v1.0/access for ASR/NLU -> JSON intent (domain/entity/action) routed by cg.l (VoiceControlManager) to per-device IR/BLE handlers -> TTS returned as MP3 and decoded locally by libmibraindec (libmad). No on-device ASR or wake-word model exists in the APK. The only neural network is a 9-component Soil VAD (vad_2.1.0_0, 1.13 MB) embedded in libmibrainvad2.so via the exported symbol mdata_vad; it is shipped but not referenced by this APK's Java code (the SDK's classic vadInit/vadCheckBegin VAD is used instead when AsrRequest.setUseVad(true) with VadMode.VAD_MODE_LOCAL, the app's defaults).

features.name: Voice control of IR/BLE devices (TV, STB, AC, fan, light, projector, DVD, amp, purifier, heater, camera)
pipeline: cg.l.o(): builds {'all_devices':[...]} context, AsrRequest.setUseVad(true), NlpRequest.setContext("mi_remote", json), SpeechEngine.startIntegrally(needAsr+needNlp)
libmibrainsdk: vadCheckBegin/vadCheckEnd local VAD, Opus encode, protobuf over wss TLS
cg.l.b.onResult: domain tvChannelControl -> cg.f; else entity -> cg.a/cg.g/cg.b/cg.e handlers -> device ee.j -> IR/BLE/MiLink command
models: vad_2.1.0_0 (shipped, not used by app code)

models.format: soil-binn container (Xiaomi Soil/CornVad) wrapping a Soil binary NN graph; extracted from libmibrainvad2.so exported symbol mdata_vad (vaddr 0x4fd90, 1132916 bytes, mdata_vad_length at 0x164704); sha256 5e4d9ff470f763883bb6a2c6043e009059b855f97da9aa73fe3c4bda55816c66

io.input: [T, 840] float32 = 40 MFCC cepstra x 21 frames (left/right context 10)
io.frontend: 25 ms frames, pre-emphasis 0.97, Povey window, 512-pt FFT, 40 mel bins 40-7800 Hz, 40 cepstra, CMVN

ops: posterior smoothing (win 5) + decoder min-voice 50 / min-sil 60 frames
models.verification: reimpl/verify.txt: pipeline runs end-to-end with the real affine weights (W1 300x840, W3 300x100, W7 2x100), prints all shapes and exits 0; no numeric comparison against the ARM library was possible (no aarch64 execution environment). pnorm/normalize arithmetic and CMVN scaling are ARCHITECTURE_ONLY.

reimplementation.limitations: Only the on-device VAD stage exists in the APK, so only it was reimplemented. Affine weights are real extracted floats; the Soil graph (9 components, dependencies) is recovered exactly (the binary stream is consumed to the last byte). pnorm window and normalize arithmetic are reconstructed from configuration fields only; the embedded CMVN array magnitudes (~1e10) are incompatible with log-cepstra so the demo falls back to on-line CMVN. ASR/NLU/TTS are cloud services: documented (WebSocket endpoints, AI_CMD_*/RESULT_* ids, Opus/MP3 codec, *_TOKEN-V1 auth headers) but not stubbed in code.

unknowns: Exact arithmetic of ComponentPnormPropgate / ComponentNormalizePropgate (only configuration recovered).
Semantic of the embedded CMVN array (82 values, magnitudes ~1e10-1e12): whether features are log-cepstra or linear power/mel domain.
The classic VAD inside libmibrainsdk.so (vadInit 0x16e20 / detector 0x41de0) was not fully reversed (log/exp based adaptive detector).
Cloud ASR/NLU/TTS model internals and the protobuf schema of the speech messages (only message ids and field strings were recovered).
Whether vad_2.1.0_0 is ever activated at runtime (no Java reference to MibrainVad2 in this APK).
The iFly voice-engine install prompt has no code reference in any dex string table; the external engine package name could not be recovered.
Exact Opus frame size / bitrate chosen by libmibrainsdk when the app passes codecMode=0, opusFrameSize=0, opusBitrates=0 (AsrRequest defaults).
Whether TTS is audible on a real device: the stream player runs in TTSMode 1 (PCM callback) and cg.l$c.onPCMData is an empty method, so the decoded MP3 has no sink in this build.

data_pipelines.name: Voice control turn: mic PCM -> local VAD -> Opus -> WSS cloud ASR/NLP -> intent -> IR

trigger.ui: cg.k (VoiceControlActivity fragment) mic button onClick -> cg.l.p(activity,view) -> cg.l.o()
trigger.lifecycle: one native context per turn; forceStop() at the start of every turn; endSpeech()/forceStop() on cancel

audio_in.buffer_bytes: AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(16000,16,2) (platform value; 1280 B on AOSP -> 80 ms chunks)
audio_in.read_samples_per_call: minBufferSize (byte count reused as short count; 2x minBufferSize bytes)
audio_in.confidence: confirmed for the code, inferred for the concrete 1280/2560 values

uplink.codec: Opus (libopus, CodecMode/Opus-Frame-Size tags); PCM mode available via USE_ENCODER_PCM
uplink.codec_params_from_app: codecMode=0, opusFrameSize=0, opusBitrates=0 (app never calls setEncodeMode) -> SDK defaults; exact frame size/bitrate unknown

downlink.format: JSON text produced by native from protobuf frames

preprocessing.what: classic SDK VAD on raw PCM chunks (25 ms window / 10 ms hop)
Opus encode of the same PCM into websocket frames

model_invocation.on_device: no ASR/NLU model; VAD only (classic detector inside libmibrainsdk; NN vad_2.1.0_0 shipped but unused)
model_invocation.cloud: ASR + NLU per turn; no local fallback

output_postprocessing.intent_dispatch: cg.l$b.onResult parses SpeechResult.getAnswer().intention{domain,entity,action}; domain==tvChannelControl -> cg.f + yd.k.g.f72699a.G(); else entity -> handler map cg.l.f12217c {aircondition:cg.a, fan:cg.b, stb:cg.f, tv:cg.g}; device from device_list or handler default

consumer.ir: handler.b() -> ee.j.E(key) -> re.g (ConsumerIrManager.transmit(freq,int[]) or Miir.d) on re.g Handler thread; AC path via KKACManagerV2 -> re.g.j(...)
consumer.ble: not reachable from the voice handlers (no GATT write in cg.a/b/f/g)
consumer.confidence: confirmed for IR/UI, inferred for BLE (absence)

buffers_and_threads.native_drop_policy: none; full ring returns -7 (MIBRAINSDK_ERR_BUFFERQUEUE) and the turn aborts
buffers_and_threads.timestamps: none per chunk; per-turn request_id/session_id + native duration counter ctx+0x628 (bytes/32000.0 s)

failure_and_fallback.cloud_error: meta.type=ERROR -> response.error_code/error_msg -> SpeechError(type=1) -> UI string only
failure_and_fallback.local_fallback: none (no on-device ASR); no Java reconnect, new native context per turn

data_pipelines.name: Spoken answer: speak(text) -> MP3 chunks -> libmad -> PCM callback (no sink in this app)

trigger.ui: cg.k.b(String)/cg.k.g(String) -> cg.l.n(String) (also cg.l.n on the NLU fallback text)

transport.downlink: RESULT_TTS_BEGIN (meta.tts.codec) + binary MP3 frames (onRequestTTSResult with empty text) + RESULT_TTS_END

preprocessing.note: MP3 bytes are fed straight into a PipedOutputStream for the native decoder

model_invocation.decoder: com.xiaomi.ai.mibrain.MibrainMp3Decoder (JNI libmibraindec.so = libmad 0.15.1b) when TTSDecoderConfig.sUseHardDecoder == false (default)
model_invocation.unused_alternative: com.xiaomi.ai.streamplayer.d (MediaCodec hard decoder) — selected only if sUseHardDecoder is true, which the app never sets

output_postprocessing.decoded_frame: streamplayer.a$C0169a{sample_rate, channels, bit, eof, pcm[]} -> PCMInfo{sample_rate,channels,bit,eof,pcm}
output_postprocessing.play_modes: mode 2 = write bytes to AudioTrack; mode 1 = PCM callback to TtsListener.onPCMData
output_postprocessing.mode_used: 1 (com.xiaomi.ai.c constructor sets f17129x=1; cg.l never calls setTTSMode)
output_postprocessing.sink_in_app: cg.l$c.onPCMData and onPlayStart are empty -> PCM discarded; AudioTrack created in mode 1 is play()ed but never written
output_postprocessing.audible_result: no audible TTS from this SDK path (inferred from code)
output_postprocessing.confidence: confirmed for code path, inferred for audible consequence

consumer.ui: onPlayFinish -> cg.l.f.i() (empty in cg.k) and Handler messages for the answer text

buffers_and_threads.pipe: PipedInputStream/PipedOutputStream (default 1024-byte buffer) between MP3 feed and decoder
threads: decode thread = libmad JNI thread started by MibrainMp3Decoder.start()
player thread = streamplayer.k$b (40 ms idle poll)
buffers_and_threads.audio_track: AudioTrack(streamType=3, sampleRate, chCfg 4|12, PCM16, getMinBufferSize, MODE_STREAM)

failure_and_fallback.codec: only "mp3" accepted; k.a(String) throws RuntimeException otherwise
failure_and_fallback.tts_error: streamplayer listener a(k,int,String) -> SpeechError{stage=STAGE_TTS, type=2} -> notifyTtsError (cg.l ignores)
failure_and_fallback.fallback: none; if decoding fails the answer stays text-only
